about.title: Clovis Car Accident Claims
about.longDescription: Clovis closed out 2025 with 356 injury collisions on record, 509 people hurt, and one traffic death, according to public data for Fresno County. Shaw Avenue, Herndon Avenue, Clovis Avenue, and W Shaw Avenue carried the largest share of reported crashes, and Friday evenings between 5 and 7 p.m. saw the highest counts. Those are simply the numbers. Behind each one is someone sorting out a tow bill, a sore neck that got worse overnight, and a voicemail from an adjuster who wants a recorded statement. If that is where you are, take a breath. You do not have to talk to the other driver's insurer yet, and you should not give a recorded account until you have had advice. LawProactive is not a law firm. We are a free service that pairs Clovis residents with an independent personal injury attorney who handles car crash claims on contingency, meaning no fee unless there is a recovery. California allows most drivers two years to file, less when a public agency is involved.

whyChoose.title: Why Clovis Drivers Turn to LawProactive

items.title: Deadlines here are shorter than people expect
items.desc: California gives most car crash victims two years to file, but a claim involving a city vehicle or a road maintained by a public agency can require notice in as little as six months. An attorney can pin down which clock applies to your Clovis collision before it runs out.

items.title: Partial fault does not end your claim
items.desc: Under California's pure comparative fault rule, you can still recover even if you were partly responsible; your share is reduced by your percentage of blame rather than erased. That matters when the other insurer tries to pin a Shaw Avenue lane change on you.

items.title: Evidence and silence both work in your favor
items.desc: Dashcam footage, photos of the intersection, and the police report fade or get harder to obtain with time, and a recorded statement to the other insurer can be used against you. The attorneys in our network help preserve what matters and handle those calls, at no fee unless there is a recovery.

items.question: I was rear-ended on Herndon Avenue during Friday rush hour. The other driver's insurer keeps calling. What should I do?
items.answer: You are not required to give them a recorded statement, and it is generally wise to decline until you have spoken with an attorney. Keep your own notes, your photos, and any medical paperwork from the visit you made afterward. LawProactive can connect you with an independent Clovis attorney, free, who can take over those conversations.

items.question: Does LawProactive charge me anything to connect me with an attorney?
items.answer: No. Our connection service is free, and we are not a law firm. The independent attorneys in our network handle car accident cases on a contingency basis, so there is no fee unless there is a recovery in your case.

items.question: The crash was partly my fault. Can I still bring a claim in California?
items.answer: Yes. California follows pure comparative fault, which means your recovery is reduced by your percentage of responsibility rather than eliminated. Whether you were 10 percent or 60 percent at fault, you may still pursue compensation for medical bills, lost wages, and pain and suffering, and California places no cap on non-economic damages in ordinary car crash cases.
